_about: Acceptance 2026-10-28 (QA B-1): tolls on an approximate route (the road model, Route.synthetic: a straight leg x the road factor, no road refs), the phone's main offline mode.

A leg of such a route whose both ends lie within followKm of a toll corridor is taken to drive that toll road between the two projections. Its price is the corridor's whole-road price x the share of the corridor the leg covers, marked «примерно» in the waybill. A projection within endSnapKm of a corridor end is that end: the toll road starts and ends at the city's ring road, the anchor is the city centre.

Prices are NOT new figures: each one is the whole-road sum from resources/toll_rates.json («how» of that road, category 1, as of the same date). Anchor points are the centres of the towns the road passes (catalogue coordinates), so the corridor is a polyline through them, not the road's geometry.
A road without a whole-road price in toll_rates.json (М-1, М-3, ЦКАД: only short sections known) has no corridor here: an approximate route along it says the tolls are not counted.
